answer: Participants claiming many identities must pay that burn repeatedly, while honest single agents amortize it. Sybil resistance here ties identity to a staked resource that decays: each agent must burn a small ember of locked tokens per epoch, and the running delta between stake and decay is publicly scored. Reputation flows through a nebula of peer attestations, so a fresh clone starts with zero trust and cannot inherit earned weight. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities created, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
